language.description: Output language override (e.g. 'auto', 'en', 'vi', 'ja'). Falls back to $LC_ALL / $LC_MESSAGES / $LANG when 'auto'.

gemini_api_key.description: Google Gemini API key for direct HTTP summarization (zero subprocess overhead).

gemini_model.description: Gemini model ID for direct API calls (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash').

anthropic_api_key.description: Anthropic API key for direct HTTP summarization (zero subprocess overhead).

anthropic_model.description: Anthropic Claude model ID for direct API calls (e.g. 'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022').

claude_model.description: Claude Code model for CLI fallback/invoker (e.g. 'haiku', 'claude-3-5-sonnet', 'default').

antigravity_model.description: Antigravity CLI model for CLI fallback/invoker (e.g. 'gemini-3.7-flash-low', 'flash_lite', 'default').
